title: Add defensive self-pair validation to canonical_pair_seed
goal: Prove that the JESTER control plane can safely execute a small real code change, verify it, and produce a structured implementation report.
constraints: Do not modify authentication or authorization behavior.
Do not modify birth-data privacy boundaries.
Do not modify canonical product or architecture specifications.
Do not modify the jester-orchestrator skill.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one small, justified application-code improvement is implemented.
The change is directly relevant to an existing application behavior.
Existing behavior outside the selected improvement remains unchanged.
A factual implementation report is produced under .jester/reports/implementations/.
The task reaches review state and does not move to completed without explicit reviewer approval.
verification: Inspect the selected file and identify the smallest reasonable improvement.
Implement the improvement without unrelated changes.
Run the narrowest relevant tests first.
Run the appropriate broader verification if required.
Inspect git diff and git status.
Confirm no prohibited files were changed.
Move the task from active to review.
blocked_reason: Execution was manually interrupted during implementation; recovery was successful; no code changes remain; the task's original implementation scope was intentionally too open-ended for this orchestration validation; a new controlled task will be used instead.
